description: Specialist Council ledger: record each finished subagent's token use for `council.py cost`

hooks.command: for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/council.py" hook subagent-stop; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit $rc;; esac; done; exit 0
